CustomField.description: Raw email addresses that also receive the Citywire run failure/zero-update alert email, one per line, in addition to the resolved Alert Queues.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter one email address per line to notify recipients with no Salesforce User (e.g. a shared mailbox). These are added on top of the members of Alert Queues Developer Names, not instead of them.
CustomField.label: Alert Additional Email Addresses
